# SPECTRA design program, iteration 4
# Topology: 5T NMOS-pair OTA (PMOS diode/mirror load) -> inverter A -> inverter B.
# outn is non-inverting w.r.t. vinp; two inverters restore vout HIGH when vinp > vinn.

VDD = 1.8
IREF_DEFAULT = 2e-6
CG_PER_UM = 1.4e-15

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (16, 12, 22),      # preamp pair gm/Id
    "L_in":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),   # preamp pair length
    "gmid_ld":  (8, 5, 14),        # PMOS load gm/Id
    "L_ld":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),   # PMOS load length
    "gmid_mir": (22, 18, 26),      # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id (ref and tail share it)
    "kt":       (4.0, 2.0, 6.0),   # tail current ratio: Itail = kt * IREF
    "Wa":       (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),  # inverter A NMOS width (um), PMOS = 2*Wa
    "Wb":       (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),  # inverter B NMOS width (um), PMOS = 2*Wb
}


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", IREF_DEFAULT)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)

    Itail = p["kt"] * iref
    Ihalf = 0.5 * Itail
    Wa = p["Wa"]
    Wb = p["Wb"]

    # ---- bias: NMOS mirror, shared L and gm/Id so the current ratio holds ----
    m_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_mir"], 0.5, iref, vds=0.7)
    m_tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_mir"], 0.5, Itail, vds=0.15)

    # ---- preamp: NMOS pair + PMOS diode/mirror load ----
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ihalf, vds=0.6)
    m_ld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ihalf, vds=0.9)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_ref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_tail)
    n.dev("MINP", "outp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("MINN", "outn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("MLDD", "outp", "outp", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)    # diode load (vinp side)
    n.dev("MLDM", "outn", "outp", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld)    # mirror load (vinn side)
    n.M("MIAN", "x", "outn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wa, 0.15)
    n.M("MIAP", "x", "outn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * Wa, 0.15)
    n.M("MIBN", "vout", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, 0.15)
    n.M("MIBP", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * Wb, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gain1 = m_in.gm / (m_in.gds + m_ld.gds)

    # outn node: inverter A gate + pair drain + mirror drain
    Cn = m_in.cdd + m_ld.cdd + CG_PER_UM * (Wa + 2.0 * Wa)
    # x node: inverter B gate + inverter A drain
    Cx = CG_PER_UM * (Wb + 2.0 * Wb) + CG_PER_UM * (Wa + 2.0 * Wa) * 0.5

    # preamp swing to switch inverter A (~0.3 V) at Ihalf
    t1 = Cn * 0.3 / Ihalf
    # inverter A drives x node through ~0.9 V swing
    t2 = Cx * 0.9 / (0.4e-3 * Wa)
    # inverter B drives CL
    t3 = cl * (VDD / 2) / (0.4e-3 * Wb)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    # Supply: reference branch + tail (inverters draw no static current)
    power = VDD * (iref + Itail)

    # Offset: inverter-A threshold mismatch referred to the preamp input
    offset = 0.01 / gain1

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": 1}
